home_body: Help build a reliable corpus, then automatically generate sentence lists.
home_validate_description: Indicate whether the proposed sentences are correct, plausible, and appropriate to help improve the generator.
home_generate_description: Create sentence lists in just a few clicks.
validate_instruction: Mark the sentence correct only if it is syntactically valid, semantically plausible, and non-offensive.
validate_empty_body: Every candidate sentence is currently accepted, rejected, or waiting for new generated input.
generate_instruction: Configure your filters and generate up to {maxLists} parallel lists with no overlap between them.
generate_disabled_body: Generation will be available once at least one accepted sentence exists.
generate_partial_notice: Only {actual} of the {requested} requested items matched your filters.
generate_balance_help: Pick words so each list approximates the French phoneme distribution.
generate_unbalanced_warning: Some lists deviate notably from the target phoneme distribution. Try increasing the items per list for a closer match.
